description: Plagueheart Sandals Level 60 Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Sandals if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Sandals, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Sandals - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 12 - Mooncloth x 2 - Cured Rugged Hide x 3
